field_order_rule: checkpoint.fields order is authoritative and identical across exports

round_trip.display_value_parity: canonical_cell exact for CSV/XLSX; JSON preserves native values
round_trip.missing_value: empty cell/string in CSV/XLSX; null or absent source normalized to null/empty by field projection
round_trip.nested_value: canonical JSON string with sorted keys for CSV/XLSX

source_immutability: Dataset JSONL is append-only; user edits are overlay-only and do not mutate source lines
